claude_proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke destroys the target outright on a failed save. Transport or damage atoms are not honest substitutes for unconditional destruction with no remains.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.on_touch_or_hold_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The talisman deals damage automatically to qualifying creatures that touch it and repeatedly at turn end while they keep holding or carrying it. Passive operations currently only support elapsed-time cadence.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.any_of
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Two mechanics are gated by wearing-or-holding the item. The current predicate grammar can express AND via all_of, but not OR.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.target_type_disadvantage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke modifies the target's saving throw only when the target is a Fiend or Undead. The current save-gate surface has no place for target-type-conditioned save disadvantage.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save.
